about: Katherina B. Alznauer is an attorney providing legal services covering Immigration: Business and Immigration: Consumer.

Katherina Alznauer, who practices law in Encino, California, was selected to Rising Stars for 2020 - 2024. Prior to becoming an attorney, she studied at University of West Los Angeles. She graduated in 2011. After passing the bar exam, she was admitted to legal practice in 2014.
